# `matrix`

Helper: `matrix(cols, rows, { foot })`, cells `mxIn(label, value, { ph, suf })`, `mxSel(label, value)`, `mxCk(label, on)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap (`MatrixGrid`: `TableShell` whose cells hold `Field`s) · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): none

## Anatomy

Table whose cells can hold fields: a select, a number input with suffix, a checkbox, or inline blocks.

## Variants

- Select cell (`mxSel`)
- Input cell (`mxIn`, with `ph`, `suf`)
- Check cell (`mxCk`)

## States

- As field states inside a cell

## Tokens

table tokens + field tokens, text-body, text-label

## Do

- Give every field cell an accessible name (`label`)

## Don't

- Do not use it for read-only data (table)

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Web-only. Input max width 200, min height 34.

## Mobile (390)

Rows become cards like a table.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

**web-only.** A table whose cells may hold fields: the threshold matrix of the care agent (WK9-WK14): a depth dropdown per situation row and the message-type table with a number field and a checkbox per row (SLA and send-window values, WK15-WK17, are plain `card` + `input` fields, no `matrix`; the tuning parameters, WJ105-WJ115, are `TuningGroup` cards). `cols` as in `table()`; a cell is a text (`\n` = small grey line), a field cell (`label` = its accessible name, which the spec lists and the coverage check reads), or inline blocks. 390: every row becomes a card like `table()`
